Thanks — quick legal guidance: 

- Acceptable additional insured wording: "Acme Corporation, its affiliates and subsidiaries" is fine, but if Acme prefers the broader phrasing we need a short list of major subsidiaries or the corporate group name to avoid ambiguity in indemnity carve-outs.
- Endorsement type: CG 20 10 (or equivalent) is acceptable. If Acme requires primary & non-contributory that should be explicitly written into the endorsement.
- Limits: Must match the MSA: Per-occurrence $1,000,000; General aggregate $2,000,000.
- Timing: If broker can provide COI + endorsement prior to countersignature, great. Otherwise require delivery within 7 business days post-countersignature. Please capture the delivery commitment in the mutual action plan / PO so procurement can proceed.

I'll sign off on the exact text once Ben confirms the endorsement form.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Legal Operations
